top.title: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. INVESTOR ALERT: Kirby McInerney LLP Announces Investigation Into Potential Securities Fraud
top.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating ADTRAN Holdings for potential securities fraud following the company's announcement of preliminary Q2 2026 results that significantly missed guidance. ADTRAN reported revenue of $280-282 million and non-GAAP operating margin of 3.5-4.0%, falling short of prior guidance of $283-303 million revenue and 5-9% margin. The company attributed the miss to a project delay from a single customer and elevated component/freight costs. ADTRAN stock declined 14% on the news.

top.title: EMBC INVESTOR ALERT: Class Action Lawsuit Filed on Behalf of Embecta Corp. Investors – Holzer & Holzer, LLC Encourages Investors With Losses to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Shareholder class action lawsuits have been filed against Embecta Corp. and Via Transportation Inc., with allegations of false statements and failure to disclose segment weakness and revenue guidance disruptions. Additionally, Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced an investigation into ADTRAN Holdings Inc. regarding potential federal securities law violations. Investors who suffered losses during the relevant periods are encouraged to contact the law firm.

top.title: ADTN INVESTOR ALERT: Holzer & Holzer, LLC Announces Investigation of ADTRAN Holdings, Inc.
top.summary: ADTRAN Holdings announced preliminary Q2 2026 results below guidance, citing a project delay from a single customer and elevated component and freight costs. The stock price declined following the announcement, prompting a securities investigation by Holzer & Holzer, LLC.

top.title: VIA INVESTOR ALERT: Class Action Lawsuit Filed on Behalf of Via Transportation, Inc. Investors – Holzer & Holzer, LLC Encourages Investors With Losses to Contact the Firm
top.summary: Holzer & Holzer, LLC has filed shareholder class action lawsuits against Via Transportation and Embecta Corp., alleging false and misleading statements in their IPO registration statements and securities disclosures. The firm is also investigating ADTRAN Holdings for potential federal securities law violations. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to contact the firm.

top.title: Blowing Agent Market Size to Reach USD 2.94 Billion by 2035 on Rising Demand for Low-GWP Insulation Solutions | SNS Insider
top.summary: The global blowing agent market is projected to grow from USD 1.79 billion in 2025 to USD 2.94 billion by 2035, driven by increasing demand for eco-friendly foam insulation, regulatory requirements to ban high-GWP compounds, and energy-efficient building construction. Chemical blowing agents dominate with 51.8% market share, while HFO technology is the fastest-growing segment. North America leads with 32.5% market share, with the U.S. market expected to reach USD 0.56 billion by 2035, while Europe is projected to reach USD 0.66 billion.

The investigation was triggered by Reuters reporting on Barclays' £600 million exposure to failed UK mortgage lender Market Financial Solutions Ltd, which caused Barclays' stock to decline 3.99% on February 27, 2026, and an additional 2.3% on March 2, 2026. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

top.summary: Blue Gold Limited received a Nasdaq notification that it failed to maintain the minimum Market Value of Publicly Held Shares (MVPHS) of $15 million for 30 consecutive business days. The company has until January 20, 2027, to regain compliance or face potential delisting. Blue Gold intends to transfer its listing to The Nasdaq Capital Market and actively monitor its MVPHS to meet compliance requirements.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Notice to Long-Term Shareholders of Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI); EquipmentShare.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: EQPT); Photronics, Inc. (NASDAQ: PLAB); and PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (NASDAQ: PRCT): Grabar Law Office is Investigating Claims on Your Behalf
top.summary: Grabar Law Office has initiated investigations on behalf of shareholders of four NASDAQ-listed companies: Cogent Communications (CCOI), EquipmentShare (EQPT), Photronics (PLAB), and PROCEPT BioRobotics (PRCT). The investigations allege breaches of fiduciary duties, including misrepresentation of business fundamentals, undisclosed related-party transactions, false demand statements, and artificially inflated sales figures. Shareholders who purchased shares before specified dates and still hold them may seek corporate reforms and damages at no cost.

top.title: ROSEN, A LEADING INVESTOR RIGHTS LAW FIRM, Encourages Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - CCOI
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Cogent Communications Holdings, Futu Holdings Limited, and AeroVironment, Inc. The Cogent lawsuit alleges materially false statements regarding optical wavelength backlog, customer demand, revenue targets, dividend sustainability, and insider stock pledging activities. Investors who purchased shares during specified class periods may be eligible for compensation. Lead plaintiff deadlines and joining instructions are provided.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+9.1% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +9.1%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -6.1 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -6.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -10.9 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -10.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Futu Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: FUTU) for allegedly making materially false or misleading statements regarding regulatory compliance and financial reporting. Investors who purchased FUTU securities between May 24, 2023 and May 27, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit.

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Helen of Troy Limited for allegedly misleading investors about Project Pegasus, a restructuring initiative. The company claimed the project was delivering efficiencies and cost savings, but in reality lacked sufficient resources and budget to achieve stated goals. When the truth emerged in July 2024, the company reported a 49% decline in earnings per share and cut full-year revenue outlook by over 20%, causing stock price to drop 27.7%. Investors who purchased shares between April 24, 2024, and October 8, 2025, can join the lawsuit with a deadline of August 3, 2026.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -9.1 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -9.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: PRIM INVESTOR ALERT: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces that Primoris Services Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit
top.summary: Law firm Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announced class action lawsuits against Primoris Services Corporation for allegedly making false statements about cost estimation and project management in its renewable energy business. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased PRIM stock between August 5, 2025 and June 22, 2026. Primoris stock experienced significant declines following multiple negative disclosures about cost overruns and guidance reductions. The firm is seeking a lead plaintiff by September 21, 2026.

top.title: $INTU Lawsuit Notice: BFA Law Reminds Intuit Investors of September 8 Lead Plaintiff Deadline After 20% Stock Drop Triggers Securities Fraud Class Action
top.summary: A securities fraud class action has been filed against Intuit Inc. after its stock plummeted 20% on May 21, 2026, following revelations that the company misled investors about TurboTax's competitive advantages and growth prospects. Intuit allegedly faced undisclosed pricing pressure from price-sensitive DIY tax filers and failed to deliver expected tax season performance. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 8, 2026.

top.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces that Intuit Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit - INTU
top.summary: Law firm Robbins Geller has announced class action lawsuits against Intuit Inc. for allegedly making false statements about competitive advantages and TurboTax revenue growth, resulting in a 20% stock drop after weak Q3 results. The firm is also filing cases against EquipmentShare.com and PROCEPT BioRobotics for similar securities fraud allegations.

top.title: ROSEN, A SKILLED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Intuit Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - INTU
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Intuit Inc. for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements about its competitive advantages, business model, and TurboTax revenue growth guidance. The lawsuit claims Intuit overstated its strength while losing significant business due to competitive and pricing pressures. Investors who purchased Intuit securities between August 22, 2025 and May 20, 2026 may be entitled to compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 8, 2026.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID) Investors Who Suffered Losses to a Securities Class Action – Deadline is July 28, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Lucid Group on behalf of investors who purchased shares between February 25, 2026 and April 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Lucid made false and misleading statements regarding its manufacturing capabilities and financial performance. The company disclosed a supplier quality issue that disrupted Gravity deliveries for 29 days, resulting in significant stock price declines of 11.35% and 4.76% following separate announcements in early April 2026. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is July 28, 2026.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for AVAV, CALX, ZTS, and LCID: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz Reminds Investors of Class Actions on Behalf of Shareholders
top.summary: Class action lawsuits have been filed against AeroVironment, Calix, Zoetis, and Lucid Group, alleging that company executives made materially false statements and failed to disclose material adverse facts about their businesses. The lawsuits cover various issues including understated competition, supply chain problems, declining product adoption, and manufacturing disruptions. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from July 27-28, 2026.

top.title: LVMH : Accélération de la croissance au 2ème trimestre ; résultats semestriels solides
top.summary: LVMH posted first-half 2026 sales of €38.6 billion with organic growth of +2%, accelerating to +3% in Q2. Operating margin remained strong at 22.5% with €8.7 billion operating income. The luxury conglomerate showed resilience despite geopolitical challenges, with notable strength in Watches & Jewelry (+9% organic), recovery in Wines & Spirits (+5%), and solid performance from Sephora and flagship stores in Asia.

top.title: LVMH: Accelerating growth in the second quarter; solid first-half results
top.summary: LVMH posted €38.6 billion in first-half 2026 revenue with 2% organic growth, accelerating to 3% in Q2. Profit from recurring operations reached €8.7 billion with a 22.5% operating margin. The luxury conglomerate showed resilience despite geopolitical disruptions, with strong performance from Watches & Jewelry (11% Q2 growth), Wines & Spirits recovery, and Sephora's sustained expansion. Fashion & Leather Goods returned to organic growth in Q2.

top.title: Wall Street ends mixed as investors focus on tech earnings
top.summary: STORY: Wall Street ended mixed on Monday, with the Dow gaining half a percent, the S&P 500 virtually flat and the Nasdaq dropping marginally.Investors awaited earnings results from Big Tech companies this week, including Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple. Of the four, only Apple has seen significant gains this year, with investors concerned about future returns on massive AI spending.Skyler Weinand is chief investment officer at Regan Capital."If they don't come out and beat [estimates], they're going to sell off even further. You're going to see some profit taking. You're going to see some hedge funds and retail [investors] potentially pack it in for the rest of the year, sitting up 10 to 15%. I don't blame them. // I don't really see the opportunity for these companies that have run so much over the past 18 to 24 months on that AI build out. I don't see that as a huge buying opportunity. I would rather be looking at some of the companies that have fallen behind a little bit. Auto manufacturers are having their day right now. Defense companies are having their day. Some of these companies that will continue to print earnings regardless of what comes from AI build out."The Philadelphia semiconductor index extended its recent selloff, falling more than 2%. It is down 21% from its record high close on June 22 but remains up 63% in 2026.Chinese chipmaker CXMT's stellar debut on Monday and a report that the country has started manufacturing homegrown deep ultraviolet chipmaking tools also signaled intensifying competition for the U.S. semiconductor industry.Meanwhile, oil prices slid after President Donald Trump said the administration was having "good talks" with Iran, but warned that U.S. strikes would resume if the negotiations failed to deliver.Shares of Occidental Petroleum fell more than 4% and Exxon Mobil also closed lower.Traders this week will also turn their attention to Tuesday's start of the Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting, with traders projecting a more than 60% chance that the central bank will leave rates unchanged, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

top.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Microvast Holdings, Inc. Investors
top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Microvast Holdings on behalf of investors who purchased securities between April 1, 2025 and March 16, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Microvast misrepresented its manufacturing expansion capabilities and margin improvement targets. The company's stock fell 34.2% on March 17, 2026, after disclosing a sharp decline in gross margins to 1% and a 15% year-over-year revenue decrease, attributed to inventory issues and customer delays.

top.title: ROSEN, A HIGHLY RECOGNIZED LAW FIRM, Encourages Microvast Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - MVST
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit on behalf of Microvast Holdings investors who purchased securities between April 1, 2025 and March 16, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding margin targets, inventory management issues, delays in commercial vehicle rollouts, and the completion timeline of the Huzhou Phase 3.2 expansion. Investors must move the court by September 21, 2026 to serve as lead plaintiff.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+5.0% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +5.0%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +1.7 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +1.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company is expanding its animal therapy business with 17 certified clinics treating over 200 animals, establishing dual manufacturing facilities in the U.S. and India, and preparing for international clinical trial expansion with strong interest from multiple countries.

top.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors
top.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit on behalf of Regeneron Pharmaceuticals investors who purchased securities between August 1, 2025 and May 15, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Regeneron made false statements about its Phase III Fianlimab-Libtayo clinical trial, misrepresenting the study's prospects while downplaying risks. The trial ultimately failed to reach statistical significance on its primary endpoint, causing Regeneron's stock to drop approximately 10% on May 15, 2026.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Enhanced Capital Announces Release of 2025 Community Impact Report
top.summary: Enhanced Capital, a private credit strategy of Ridgepost Capital, released its 2025 Community Impact Report showing deployment of over $350 million across 65 projects in 24 states. Since inception, the firm has raised $6.8 billion supporting over 1,000 projects and businesses, installed 809 megawatts of clean energy capacity in 2025, and supported over 3,900 jobs. The firm received a $65 million New Markets Tax Credit allocation and launched its Missouri Rural Fund.

top.summary: The global blowing agent market is projected to grow from USD 1.79 billion in 2025 to USD 2.94 billion by 2035, driven by increasing demand for eco-friendly foam insulation, regulatory requirements to ban high-GWP compounds, and energy-efficient building construction. Chemical blowing agents dominate with 51.8% market share, while HFO technology is the fastest-growing segment. North America leads with 32.5% market share, with the U.S. market expected to reach USD 0.56 billion by 2035, while Europe is projected to reach USD 0.66 billion.

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Wix.com (WIX) Faces Securities Class Action Amid Scrutiny Over Vibe Coding Transition, Competitive and Financial Positioning -- HBSS
top.summary: Wix.com (WIX) is facing a securities class action lawsuit after its stock plummeted 27% in May 2026 following disappointing Q1 2026 results. The company allegedly misrepresented the competitiveness and performance of its AI products (Base44 and Harmony) while understating associated costs. Operating expenses spiked 46% year-over-year, with non-GAAP S&M expenses reaching $190.7 million (88% increase), causing operating margins to collapse from 21% to 5%. Management acknowledged competitive challenges and product gaps during earnings calls.

top.title: WIX LAWSUIT: Wix.com Ltd. Sued for Securities Law Violations; Investors Should Contact Block & Leviton To Learn How They Might Recover Losses
top.summary: Block & Leviton has filed a securities fraud lawsuit against Wix.com Ltd. and its executives for allegedly misleading investors about the company's AI-powered website tools between February 2025 and May 2026. The company allegedly overstated the competitiveness of its AI offerings while understating costs. Wix's stock fell 27% on May 13, 2026, after the company reported disappointing Q1 results and acknowledged product deficiencies, followed by a 20% workforce reduction.
